entries.49c38cb5bc26038a: A business that consistently supports client companies, from building marketing strategies through ad production to ad operation, for their products and services. The group bears advertising costs to acquire new users and receives revenue-share fees from client companies according to the number of users acquired. Because client companies do not need initial fees or consulting fees, small and mid-sized companies that have difficulty securing budgets are also eligible for support. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥16,687 million, making this the core business that accounts for most of consolidated revenue.
